newsitem.title: ALBANIA: SOCCER-ALBANIAN MIDFIELDER MILLO DIES IN ACCIDENT.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ALBANIAN MIDFIELDER MILLO DIES IN ACCIDENT.

text.p: Albanian international Lefter Millo died in a car accident in Greece on Saturday, Albanian television reported.
The television quoted the Albanian soccer federation as saying that Millo, 31, died in the town of Larissa on Saturday morning.
Millo, a midfielder, had played for five years for Greek first division club Larissa.

World soccer's governing body FIFA said on Friday Albania's World Cup qualifying matches against Ukraine and Germany would be switched from Tirana to Granada in Spain because of the troubled political situation in the Balkan country.
